descriptions.preferred: Fall color is the outstanding feature of this cultivar which turns a crimson color flecked with gold or orange. The green leaf holds good color all summer and is pleasing in the garden landscape. The seven-lobed leaves are petioles are slender and about 3 cm long. This medium strong-growing plant becomes a wide, tall bush up to 4 m tall, rather than a strongly upright tree.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 秋色是该品种最突出的观赏特征，叶片会转为深红色，并点缀金色或橙色斑驳。绿色叶片整个夏季都能保持良好叶色，在园林景观中表现悦目。七裂叶片具细长叶柄，叶柄长约 3 厘米。这一中等偏强生长的品种最终会形成高可达 4 米、开展较宽的大型灌木，而非明显直立的乔木。
